answer: In this PoA design, identity verification uses a Wesolowski VDF: each claimant must execute a prescribed chain of modular squarings, with every result depending on the previous one. A cloned identity cannot compress this dependency chain by distributing steps across GPUs; each clone consumes genuine sequential time and hardware. The beacon fixes the challenge, while every thread and lotus-labeled identity remains subject to the same delay, making large-scale Sybil creation costly and time-limited.
